**Paperhue 0.3.2**: the Mac app now does everything the Windows app does:
calendar, to-do, notes and card pages, photo backgrounds, the daily
schedule. On both you set up every page first and send them all with one
push, and each page can be updated or shown on its own. On the phones every
page is set up in one place.

## What's new

### Set up everything, then push (Windows and Mac)

- Choosing photos, page kinds, backgrounds and crops, writing notes and
  choosing cards no longer sends anything. Paperhue saves your changes and
  updates the previews.
- **Push to device** sends every page in one go. The page on screen goes
  last, and pages that did not change are skipped. If the calendars can't be
  read, the calendar pages are left as they are and the rest is still sent.
- Every page has two new buttons:
  - **Update this page** sends just that page.
  - **Show on device** switches the device to that page, like pressing its
    button, without sending anything.
- **Add note** saves a note. In My cards, **Put on page N** puts a card on a
  card page. Both go to the device with the next push.

### Mac: the same as Windows

Each page on the Mac can now show:

- Today + month, Today + week, To-do, Day or Month, drawn from your
  calendars (the public Taiwan holidays calendar when none is set up), on
  white or on one of your photos;
- Notes board or Big message, with the notes you write;
- a card from **My cards…**: make and edit cards, **Put on page N**, and
  export or import .paperhue-card files to share them with the other
  Paperhue apps.

Also on the Mac: **Calendar sources…** can now edit a source as well as add
one, **Sync now** and the daily schedule (off until you add a time), the
last sync's time and result in the main window, and dropping photos onto
the window. **Verify** and **Technical details** are gone: the Mac and
Windows apps now have the same buttons.

### Phones

- **Pages** is now the one place for every page: it lists all four pages,
  including card pages (with the card that is on them). The separate Photos
  tab is gone: a page set to Photo gets its photo, crop and fit right there,
  and is sent with **Send page N**. Before, a photo page had nothing to send.
- Every page has **Show on device**, as on Windows and Mac.
- Notes board and Big message are no longer offered on the phone, which has
  no notes editor. A page set to one of them earlier becomes a Photo page
  with no photo, so the phone leaves the notes you post from a computer
  alone.
- A new **Log** section at the bottom has a **Copy log** button. If a page
  ever looks wrong on the device, send it again, then copy the log into your
  report.
- The iPhone Shortcut is called **Paperhue-Sync** everywhere, and **Sync
  now** runs it by that name.

### One phone or computer at a time

The device remembers one pairing. Pairing it with another phone or computer
makes it forget the previous one; to switch back, forget the device in that
phone's or computer's Bluetooth settings, hold the device's button for about
5 seconds until the light blinks green, and pair again. Every Paperhue app
now says so when the pairing is gone, and the README explains it.

## Download

- **Windows:** Paperhue.exe
- **Mac:** Paperhue-macOS.zip (macOS 14 or newer)
- **Android:** Paperhue-Android.apk
- **iPhone:** nothing to download. Open https://markhhm.github.io/ulani-epaper/
  in the Bluefy browser.

## Upgrading from 0.3.1

- Windows: replace Paperhue.exe with the new one.
- Android: install the new APK over the old one.
- Mac: replace Paperhue in Applications. macOS may ask once more the first
  time you open it.

Your pages and settings are kept.
